inventory.observation: One closed triangular cross-section: horizontal bottom, vertical right side, ascending lower-left to upper-right hypotenuse. Right angle is at bottom right; the two legs look equal within scan distortion.

Left external vertical ray has an upward arrow below the base. It continues upward through the bottom face near x62, meets the sloping face near (62,146), turns right along y146, and exits the right face with a rightward arrow.

Right external vertical ray has an upward arrow below the base. It continues upward through the bottom face near x100, meets the sloping face near (100,108), turns right along y108, and exits the right face with a rightward arrow.

Two distinct continuous L-shaped paths share the same prism. The left incoming ray corresponds to the lower outgoing ray; the right incoming ray corresponds to the upper outgoing ray. Incoming pair is parallel upward; outgoing pair is parallel rightward. Each path turns once on the hypotenuse, not inside the material.

Three separated clusters of short diagonal interior ink strokes are visible, approximately near (79,164), (145,137), and (159,68). They do not join a face-to-face continuous optical path, do not have a written label, and appear to be material/section hatching rather than additional rays. The coarse middle cluster's exact small-stroke shape is uncertain.

inventory.observation: One closed upward-pointing triangular cross-section with a horizontal bottom hypotenuse and two sloping faces meeting at a centered top apex. The apex is a right angle and the sloping legs appear equal within scan distortion.

Leftmost ray points upward below the base near x41, enters vertically, reflects from the left slope near (41,109), crosses horizontally right at y109, reflects from the right slope near (219,109), then travels vertically downward through the base near x219 to a downward arrow.

Second incoming ray points upward below the base near x72, reflects from the left slope near (72,80), crosses horizontally right at y80, reflects from the right slope near (188,80), then travels vertically downward through the base near x188 to a downward arrow.

Two continuous nested three-segment optical paths share one prism. Leftmost incoming maps to rightmost outgoing through the lower horizontal segment; right incoming maps to left outgoing through the upper segment. Each path has two face-bound reflections. Incoming pair is parallel upward and outgoing pair parallel downward, reversing direction by 180 degrees.

Several short diagonal stroke clusters lie in the upper triangular interior and in regions around/between the paths, including near lower-left and lower-right interior. These remain separate from continuous ray segments and have no labels. They appear to indicate material/section texture, not extra paths or numerical data.
